intermediate_experiments.scope: Initial per-field blocking; then remove extra small-field slices/loops by sharing squared-error math and adding a direct small-field path. Raw prototype/tuning measurements are exploratory, final conclusions use motion-performance-*.json.

An initially overstrict new wide-frame test asserted exact pi; all environments measured pi plus one ULP. Corrected numeric tolerance, all final suites passed; runtime unchanged by this test correction.

intermediate_experiments.reason: A shared all-field block reducer did not consistently improve the short-clip cases and added another explicit metric-denominator mapping. Keep the smaller per-field reducer with direct small-field handling; retain every raw timing including small-input regressions.

Alternative long-field targets 8/16/32/128/256Ki scalars did not establish a consistent timing improvement over64Ki across measured layouts. Smaller targets trade more loop overhead for lower scratch, larger targets increase temporary allocation. Keep the documented64Ki target and existing direct small-field path. Measurements overlapped three owned probes, so they are exploratory and are not evidence of an exclusive-host optimum.

Three earlier exact owned probes were explicitly stopped/reaped; their passed cases and timings are intermediate evidence. Final performance/tests/endurance refer to the guarded source only. Initial controller relative-path guard refused signaling and premature controller bookkeeping was corrected with actual exit143 session results, preserved in controller-guard-diagnostic.json.

limits: Scoring measurements exclude full NPZ loading, constructor validation, source/file hashing, fixture generation, simulation and training; the separate full-file pipeline explicitly includes loading/validation/hash. All timings are on a shared unpinned CPU host.

Different sizes, strides, dtypes and NumPy versions have different results. Small and many-short-clip cases can be flat or slower; inspect the signed changes in the final raw rows. All raw positive and negative measurements are retained.

Memory tracing is temporary Python/NumPy allocation, not process RSS or native/GPU memory. Reference and rollout arrays remain fully decoded in memory. Only exact ndarray inputs use blocking; subclasses retain original full-field reductions. A frame wider than65536 scalars is processed as one frame, so this is not a hard byte limit.

Metrics preserve definitions, units, shortest quaternion rotations and equal per-clip aggregation. Summation order can change final floating-point bits; tested numeric tolerances and independent analytic/Hamilton oracles are recorded.

Final-source sustained probes use their own recorded start epochs; earlier stopped candidate probes are preserved as intermediate evidence and their durations are not added to actual round time. Sampled RSS, stable FD/Python-thread counts and weakref release apply to tested workloads and are not a general leak proof. Rejection controls mutate already validated fixture objects intentionally to check score-side validation parity.
No GPU, physics, learning, real robot, network viewer delivery or general training throughput benefit is established. Optional integration test skips and warnings remain in the logs.
